title: Chapter 68 — The Go-To Position: Becoming the Market's Default
intro: Market position as an asset — reputation architecture and visibility systems.

sections.title: Becoming the Default
sections.content:
The go-to position is when builders, designers, and contractors in your market think of you first — before anyone else — when they need appliances. You are not one option among several. You are the obvious choice.

This does not happen through advertising. It happens through consistent delivery on every project, deep product expertise that other reps cannot match, visibility in the trade community, and a reputation that precedes every cold call.

sections.title: Reputation Architecture
sections.content:
Attend industry association meetings — NKBA, local home builder associations, design events. Be visible. Be helpful. Answer questions without selling.

Create content for trade professionals — spec guides, installation requirement checklists, product comparison resources. Share them freely. Position yourself as a resource, not a salesperson.

Sponsor a designer evening or a builder appreciation event once or twice a year. The investment is small. The relationship dividends are enormous.

sections.title: The Network Effect
sections.content:
Every happy builder tells 2-3 other builders. Every satisfied designer recommends you to their builder partners. One trade relationship, done well, creates three more.

After 2-3 years of consistent trade development, you stop prospecting. Accounts come to you. That is the go-to position — and it is the most defensible competitive advantage in appliance retail.
